races.name: Wee Brian Reilly Memorial EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
CELTIC STORM is shaping up well, appreciating the increase in trip and improving on his debut form when posting a good third at Kempton (1m) 16 days ago. He appeals as the type to go on progressing and can make a successful switch to turf under Billy Loughnane. Charmed Boy may emerge best of the newcomers, whilst Pen Lan Icon is another to note now her stamina is tested further.

  1. CELTIC STORM (FR)
  2. CHARMED BOY (IRE)
  3. PEN LAN ICON

races.name: Hamilton Park Nursery
races.verdict:
THE RESDEV ROMAN confirmed her initial promise following a 3-month layoff when scoring with a bit in hand at Ripon (5f) 3 weeks ago and she firmly appeals as the type to go on improving now tackling nurseries. This is competitive, though, with hat-trick seeking Space Dreamer and Aura of Melania just 2 potential dangers.

  1. THE RESDEV ROMAN (IRE)
  2. SPACE DREAMER (IRE)
  3. AURA OF MELANIA

races.name: Heineken Zero Drink Responsibly At Hamilton Park Handicap
races.verdict:
IMPRESSOR is lurking on a dangerous mark and could be worth chancing with conditions likely to be testing. Royal Duke might well have pushed Fear And Fast close had things panned out better at Musselburgh last week, so he rates as the main threat.

  1. IMPRESSOR (IRE)
  2. ROYAL DUKE
  3. FEAR AND FAST

races.name: Molton Brown Luxury Fragrance Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
JANNAS JOURNEY has had plenty of racing but she remains unexposed as a sprinter and could be worth another chance. Annie Edson Taylor had a couple of these in behind when winning over C&D early this month so is next best ahead of Persian Spirit, who should strip fitter for her comeback run.

  1. JANNAS JOURNEY (IRE)
  2. ANNIE EDSON TAYLOR
  3. PERSIAN SPIRIT (IRE)

races.name: Big Drew Hunter Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
MONOCEROS took his form up a notch when getting off the mark for current connections at Haydock earlier in the month and nudged up just 3 lb, Iain Jardine's 3-y-o gets the vote to follow up. Matter of Britain ran out a commanding winner of a C&D maiden last month, so he heads up the opposition now handicapping, with Krissy and Maximising another couple worthy of consideration, too.

  1. MONOCEROS
  2. MATTER OF BRITAIN
  3. KRISSY (IRE)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
MOTAWAARED and Empirestateofmind dominated an Ayr handicap on Friday with the former taken to reverse the form this time if allowed to take his chance. Tee Aitch Aye has worked his way back to form of late and should be thereabouts again.

  1. MOTAWAARED
  2. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE)
  3. TEE AITCH AYE (IRE)

races.name: Hampton By Hilton Hamilton Park Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for NED BROY who showed a good attitude to get off the mark at Newcastle on his latest outing. He is taken to score again for yard which landed this race last year, though dual course winner Uncle Liam is respected in his current form. Taylormade Lad is also one to note from his reduced mark.

  1. NED BROY (IRE)
  2. UNCLE LIAM (IRE)
  3. TAYLORMADE LAD (IRE)

races.name: Dominic Hill Accountants & Thorne Civil Engineers Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This looks trappy with all 3 having positives and negatives about their profile. The re-application of a hood should help SIORAI settle so she is given the tentative vote over shock Worcester scorer Galeforcechopper and returning Getarose.

  1. SIORAI (IRE)
  2. GALEFORCECHOPPER
  3. GETAROSE (IRE)

races.name: Henners Gallop To Grape-Ness Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There should be plenty more to come from PREMIER TENOR for all his all-conquering stable and he's hard to get away from, for all Arcturus Flame and Raulin possess their share of ability on the Flat.

  1. PREMIER TENOR (FR)
  2. ARCTURUS FLAME (IRE)
  3. RAULIN (IRE)

races.name: Prestige Security Executive Protection Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PREMIER FANTASY has found just one too strong in 3 of his 5 starts for current connections and this represents a good opportunity for Nick Scholfield's 7-y-o to get off the mark. Akrramm hasn't been seen for 12 months, but he can give the selection most to think about returning for new connections on hurdling debut, with Golden Garden taken to fill out third.

  1. PREMIER FANTASY (IRE)
  2. AKRRAMM
  3. GOLDEN GARDEN (USA)

races.name: Mansell McTaggart Mane Event Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JEFE TRIUNFO has fallen a long way in the weights since mixing it in better company this time last year. He's narrowly preferred to Mancero, who's entitled to go close if back on song in a change of headgear. Pooroldmackley shaped as if back in top form when last seen in July, and he completes the shortlist.

  1. JEFE TRIUNFO (FR)
  2. MANCERO (FR)
  3. POOROLDMACKLEY (IRE)

races.name: Friends & Family Remembering Norman Sharpe Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MOJITO DES MOTTES looked a useful handicapper in the making at Newton Abbot last time and may follow up to land a nice pot. Nap Hand and Eternal Angel have both made bright starts for their respective yards and are expected to go well again.

  1. MOJITO DES MOTTES (FR)
  2. NAP HAND (IRE)
  3. ETERNAL ANGEL (FR)

races.name: Only Horsepower Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
AGGAGIO was too keen for his own good back in this sphere last time, but he's worth another chance with the headgear left off on what is becoming an attractive mark. Farhh Echo is the obvious threat if turned out again quickly following his latest win at Newton Abbot on Friday.

  1. AGGAGIO (FR)
  2. FARHH ECHO (IRE)
  3. KHALK'EAU SPIGAO (FR)

races.name: Bob George Powered By Mansell McTaggart Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SHANE'S SPIRIT showed plenty of ability when fifth in a Perth bumper back in the spring and with improvement on the cards having switched to Mickey Bowen, he looks to have been found a good opportunity to get off the mark. Sole-filly Missy Moises didn't show a great deal first time up, but she's taken to chase home the selection ahead of debutant Kap In Hand.

  1. SHANE'S SPIRIT (IRE)
  2. MISSY MOISES
  3. KAP IN HAND (IRE)

races.name: Kinisla Charleville Cheese 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict:
SONNY CORLEONE showed a fair level of ability on the Flat and is worth chancing on hurdles debut for a top National Hunt yard, with the pick of that form likely to make him hard to beat. Minella Buoy has been a bit disappointing of late but rates the main danger on earlier hurdles form, while Hello Garda is respected as the only previous winner in this sphere despite a penalty.

  1. SONNY CORLEONE (IRE)
  2. MINELLA BUOY
  3. HELLO GARDA (IRE)

races.name: Kinisla Cheestrings Irish EBF Mares Hurdle
races.verdict:
LE NEZ CREUX has to concede weight all round but arrives with fewer question marks than most and is taken to open her account for current connections. Majestic Force remains unexposed over both hurdles and fences but may need this after 16 months off, while Easter Bonnet has a bit to find but can be involved if building on her previous hurdles win.

  1. LE NEZ CREUX (FR)
  2. MAJESTIC FORCE (IRE)
  3. EASTER BONNET (FR)

races.name: Kinisla Bloom Feeds Irish EBF Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHOSEN SHANT looked to win with plenty in hand over fences last time and can exploit her lower hurdle mark here. Pampar Lady may still have some mileage in her own hurdle mark, and she heads the dangers along with Radiator Springs, who looks interesting on just her second start in a handicap. Eye Of A Tiger, Regards To Rose and Wonderful Everyday are others to note in a wide-open event.

  1. CHOSEN SHANT (IRE)
  2. PAMPAR LADY (IRE)
  3. RADIATOR SPRINGS (IRE)

races.name: Kinisla Dairygold Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
RUN TED RUN can make a winning hurdle debut on the back of his promising Galway bumper success. Gillane and Rememberwhat look the pick of those with hurdling experience.

  1. RUN TED RUN (IRE)
  2. GILLANE (IRE)
  3. REMEMBERWHAT (IRE)

races.name: Kinisla Kerrymaid Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
APPLE'S OF BRESIL could hardly have been more impressive on his chase debut and, already proven when fresh, is taken to follow up en route to better things. Ocastle des Mottes has improved his jumping of late, culminating in a win last time, and he rates as the main danger if producing another clear round. Sky Lord also arrives on the back of a win and can feature if seeing things out as well again.

  1. APPLE'S OF BRESIL (FR)
  2. OCASTLE DES MOTTES (FR)
  3. SKY LORD

races.name: Kinisla Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
The vote goes to JALILA MORIVIERE to follow up from last time with the forecast strong pace sure to suit. Crowsatedappletart is entitled to be in the mix back chasing, whilst Coming Up Easy is also worth a chance to back up his recent Galway run.

  1. JALILA MORIVIERE (FR)
  2. CROWSATEDAPPLETART (IRE)
  3. COMING UP EASY (IRE)

races.name: Kinisla Farm & Home Store (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
SIR VINNY has placed in all 3 of his bumpers so far, forced to challenge wider than ideal when runner-up at Galway last time, and he could be ready to go one better. Green Hint isn't taken lightly, though, making his second start for Willie Mullins, with Bonnie Loch the pick of the remainder.

  1. SIR VINNY (IRE)
  2. GREEN HINT (IRE)
  3. BONNIE LOCH (IRE)
